data.name: Maarif
data.gender_notes: Maarif is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-F-F', meaning to educate or be educated. In Islamic tradition, knowledge and education are considered essential for spiritual growth and personal development. The name Maarif carries the meaning “Knowledge, Education” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maarif usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, education and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Seek knowledge and wisdom for the betterment of oneself and society.
data.etymology: Maarif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Education.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maarif total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: معارف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علمي مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عرف' ومعناه المعرفة العميقة والفهم الدقيق للدين والعالم، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالحكمة والفطنة. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها 'وَمَا أُوتِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ' (الإسراء: 55)، مما يعزز قيمة العلم والمعرفة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: معارف
in_urdu.meaning: دین اور دنیا کا گہرا علم و معرفت
in_urdu.long_meaning: علم اور سمجھ کا ایک خوبصورت مجموعہ، جو فرد کو دنیا اور دین کے معاملات میں بصیرت و فراست بخشتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصیل عربی جڑ 'عرف' سے ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں 'جاننا' یا 'سمجھنا'۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں بھی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جہاں علم اور حلم کو اہم صفات کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मारिफ
in_hindi.meaning: दुनिया और धर्म का गहन ज्ञान
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम व्यक्ति की गहरी समझ और ज्ञान को दर्शाता है, जो उन्हें धार्मिक और सांसारिक मामलों में अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करता है। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं, विशेष रूप से 'मारिफ' शब्द में, जो 'ज्ञान' या 'समझ' के अर्थ में प्रयोग होता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बुद्धिमत्ता और विवेक के प्रतीक के रूप में महत्व रखता है।

in_english.name: Maarif
in_english.meaning: deep knowledge and understanding of the world and religion
in_english.long_meaning: Maarif is a name that signifies profound knowledge and understanding, particularly in the realms of religion and the world. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'عرف' (ʿ-r-f), which means 'to know' or 'to understand', this name reflects the importance of wisdom and insight. Referenced in several Quranic verses, it underscores the value of knowledge in Islam. Historically, the name Maarif has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the pursuit of knowledge and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Maarif" reflects a deep cultural emphasis on the pursuit of knowledge and learning, as evident in the derived meaning 'to educate'. In many Muslim societies, the acquisition of knowledge is highly valued as a means to enrich one's life, contribute to the community, and secure a successful future for oneself and one's family. This emphasis on education is rooted in the Islamic belief that knowledge is not only a personal asset but a communal responsibility.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, knowledge is viewed as a path to understanding God's creation, discovering His truth, and knowing Him more intimately. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Seeking knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim." (At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah). The spiritual significance of the name "Maarif" thus lies in its reminder of the importance of continuous learning and spiritual growth through acquiring knowledge and wisdom. It is a call to deepen one's faith and relationship with God, by reading the Quran, studying the teachings of the Prophet (pbuh) and engaging in intellectual discussions.

'Maarif' is derived from the Arabic word 'ilm' meaning 'knowledge'. In the modern context, 'Maarif' is seen as a symbol of continuous learning and education. Three popular platforms using this name are Maarif TV, Maarif University, and Maarif Education. Maarif TV is a Turkish TV station that focuses on education and knowledge sharing. Maarif University is an international higher education institution that offers programs in various fields. Maarif Education is an educational service provider that uses technology to deliver quality education. The trend towards lifelong learning, education technology, and digital transformation has made 'Maarif' a relevant and sought-after name in the educational sector.
